manifest.name: dsh-pet-tts
manifest.description: Read dsh-pet speech bubbles aloud with Microsoft Edge's online neural voices.
manifest.author: jimmyfenwick

readme.text:
English | [中文](#中文)

Speak the [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet/tree/main/dsh-pet) pet's speech bubbles aloud using Microsoft Edge's online neural voices. The browser half watches the `.dsh-pet-bubble` DOM node; the host half synthesizes mp3 through a private Python virtualenv running the open-source [`edge-tts`](https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts) client.

Not a general-purpose "read the assistant's reply" plugin — it is scoped to the pet's own bubbles, so it stays quiet unless the pet actually says something. If you want the assistant's messages read instead, use one of the reply-reading plugins in the market.

- DeepSeek Harness with a web UI (dsh web / the desktop app's web view). Tested on 0.2.1-rc.5.
- [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet/tree/main/dsh-pet) for the bubbles (optional — the console API below works even without it).
- **Python 3.9+** on `PATH`, or point `DSH_PET_TTS_SYSTEM_PYTHON` at an interpreter.
- Network access to `speech.platform.bing.com`, and once to PyPI (or a mirror) for the one-time `edge-tts` install.
- Node.js 20+.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:jimmyfenwick/dsh-pet-tts
```

or from a release tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add https://github.com/jimmyfenwick/dsh-pet-tts/releases/latest/download/dsh-pet-tts.tgz
```

Restart or reload the host, then click once inside the page (browsers block audio before a user gesture) and let the pet say something.

On first synthesis the plugin creates a virtualenv at `~/.dsh/dsh-pet-tts/venv` and installs `edge-tts` into it — roughly 30 MB, one time, nothing global. Progress appears in the host log as `[dsh-pet-tts] creating virtualenv …` / `installing edge-tts …`.

| id | voice | rate | pitch | volume | feel |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anime-girl` (default) | zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural | +35% | +38Hz | +10% | bright, fast, anime-girl |
| `anime-girl-hi` | zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural | +35% | +50Hz | +10% | higher, childlike |
| `anime-girl-soft` | zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural | +20% | +38Hz | +10% | same pitch, calmer pace |
| `anime-boy` | zh-CN-YunxiNeural | +20% | +15Hz | +5% | young male |
| `netstar` | zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural | +25% | +25Hz | +10% | short-video narrator |
| `xiaoyi-raw` | zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural | +0% | +0Hz | +0% | natural |
| `xiaoxiao-raw` | zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural | +0% | +0Hz | +0% | natural, general purpose |
The pitch/rate values mirror the ones shipped by `dsh-pet-dfeiyu-mo`, so the same voices sound familiar.

```js
dshPetTTS.setPreset('anime-girl-hi')          // switch preset, persisted in localStorage
dshPetTTS.say('主人，我回来了')                 // speak one line immediately
dshPetTTS.say('你好', { voice: 'en-US-AriaNeural', rate: '+10%' })
dshPetTTS.mute(true)                          // silence; mute(false) to resume
Synthesized audio is cached under `~/.dsh/dsh-pet-tts/cache` keyed by text + voice + parameters, so repeated lines cost nothing.

| env var | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `DSH_PET_TTS_ROOT` | data directory (default `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet-tts`) |
| `DSH_PET_TTS_PYTHON` | use this interpreter as-is, skip the virtualenv entirely |
| `DSH_PET_TTS_SYSTEM_PYTHON` | base interpreter used to create the virtualenv |

If `pip install` cannot reach PyPI, the plugin retries the Tsinghua mirror first, then upstream PyPI; set `DSH_PET_TTS_PYTHON` to a pre-provisioned interpreter to skip installation altogether.

- Voice text is capped at 300 characters per bubble; longer lines are truncated, because a pet bubble is not a paragraph.
- Only DOM nodes with the `dsh-pet-bubble` class are spoken.
- The first sound waits for a click/keypress — browser autoplay policy, not a plugin bug.
- Synthesis needs the network; there is no offline model.
- Built for macOS/Linux. Windows code paths exist (`Scripts/python.exe`) but are untested.
- Uses Microsoft's public Edge read-aloud endpoint. It is undocumented, unaffiliated with this project, and can change or throttle without notice; check Microsoft's terms before commercial use.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-pet-tts
```

Optionally delete `~/.dsh/dsh-pet-tts` (virtualenv + cache, ~30 MB).

MIT.

---

把 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet/tree/main/dsh-pet) 桌宠的气泡台词念出来，声音走微软 Edge 的在线神经音色。前端监听 `.dsh-pet-bubble` 节点，宿主侧用私有 Python 虚拟环境里的开源客户端 [`edge-tts`](https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts) 合成 mp3。

它**只念桌宠气泡**，不念助手正文——所以桌宠不说话时它是安静的。想把助手回复念出来，请装市场里那类"朗读回复"插件。

- 带 Web UI 的 DeepSeek Harness（dsh web 或桌面版的网页视图），在 0.2.1-rc.5 上验证。
- `dsh-pet`（用于产生气泡；不装也能用控制台 API）。
- **Python 3.9+**，或者用 `DSH_PET_TTS_SYSTEM_PYTHON` 指定解释器。
- 能访问 `speech.platform.bing.com`，以及一次性访问 PyPI（或镜像）装 `edge-tts`。
- Node.js 20+。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的档名> add github:jimmyfenwick/dsh-pet-tts
```

或用 release 里的 tarball：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的档名> add https://github.com/jimmyfenwick/dsh-pet-tts/releases/latest/download/dsh-pet-tts.tgz
```

装完重启或刷新，先在页面里点一下（浏览器禁止用户手势前自动播音频），再让桌宠说话。首次合成时会在 `~/.dsh/dsh-pet-tts/venv` 建虚拟环境并装 `edge-tts`——约 30MB，一次性，不装全局。宿主机日志里会看到 `[dsh-pet-tts] creating virtualenv …` / `installing edge-tts …`。

见上表（`anime-girl` 默认）。参数与 `dsh-pet-dfeiyu-mo` 同源。

```js
dshPetTTS.setPreset('anime-girl-hi')
dshPetTTS.say('主人，我回来了')
dshPetTTS.mute(true)
await dshPetTTS.voices()
同英文节：`DSH_PET_TTS_ROOT`、`DSH_PET_TTS_PYTHON`、`DSH_PET_TTS_SYSTEM_PYTHON`；每条气泡最多念 300 字；首次发声要等一次点击；合成需要联网；macOS/Linux 验证过，Windows 路径支持未实测；用的是微软公开朗读接口，未与之关联，接口可能随时变动，商业使用前请核对微软条款。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的档名> remove dsh-pet-tts
```

如需要，再删 `~/.dsh/dsh-pet-tts`（虚拟环境 + 缓存）。MIT 许可。
